military.label: Taiwan Strait
military.text: 14 PLA aircraft, 6 PLAN vessels and 8 official ships detected around Taiwan in a single 24h window; several sorties crossed the median line.

military.label: ADIZ trend
military.text: PLA incursions into Taiwan's ADIZ hit a record 3,615 sorties in 2024 — more than double 2023's 1,669 — with the pace continuing into 2025–26.

military.label: Fujian carrier
military.text: China's 3rd carrier — first with EMALS catapults — was commissioned Nov 5, 2025 at Sanya; J-35 stealth fighters and KJ-600 AEW aircraft have since completed catapult launch trials aboard.

military.label: Defense budget
military.text: 2026 official defense budget set at RMB 1.94 trillion (~US$281B), +7% YoY — the 11th straight year of single-digit growth. Pentagon assesses real spending as 32–63% higher than declared.

military.label: South China Sea
military.text: China and the Philippines clashed three times in a single week at Scarborough and Second Thomas Shoals, prompting joint US–Philippines–Japan maritime drills.

military.label: East China Sea
military.text: China Coast Guard patrolled the Senkaku/Diaoyu contiguous zone a record 357 of 365 days in 2025 (1,380 vessel-days) amid a wider China–Japan rift over Taiwan remarks.

military.label: Live-fire drills
military.text: PLA conducted two days of live-fire exercises near Taiwan just after FM Wang Yi met US Secretary of State Rubio in the Philippines.

economic.label: GDP growth
economic.text: Q2 2026 GDP +4.3% YoY — weakest since Q4 2022 — as H1 came in at +4.7%, still inside the official 4.5–5% full-year target.

economic.label: Trade
economic.text: Exports rose 17.6% in H1 2026 (June +27% YoY) on AI-chip and EV demand, even as import growth and a weak property sector kept net trade volatile.

economic.label: US tariff status
economic.text: No comprehensive new deal has replaced Phase One; both sides maintain a 'tactical truce' — a ~30% baseline tariff regime extended through Nov 10, 2026.

economic.label: Retaliatory measures
economic.text: Beijing sanctioned 6 US entities and tightened drone-export controls, retaliating for new US forced-labor tariffs and an FCC drone import ban — weeks ahead of Xi's planned Washington visit.

economic.label: Section 301
economic.text: USTR added a further 12.5% Section 301 tariff on Chinese goods over forced-labor enforcement, lifting the cumulative rate again.

economic.label: Politburo signal
economic.text: The Politburo pledged faster fiscal spending and 'practical, timely incremental measures,' naming domestic demand and capital-market resilience as H2 priorities.

economic.label: Markets
economic.text: Shanghai Composite closed near 3,940 (+2.8% on the week); consumer prices logged a third straight month of decline even as the PBOC signalled a more dovish stance.

political.label: US summit diplomacy
political.text: Trump's May 14–15 Beijing state visit — his first China trip since 2017 — produced a 'framework for deeper cooperation'; Xi's return visit to the White House is set for Sept 24, 2026.

political.label: India border
political.text: The 36th WMCC round in New Delhi saw both sides 'engage in frank discussions' on the LAC and agree to keep using existing military-to-military channels.

political.label: Russia ties
political.text: Putin described China–Russia relations as at an 'unprecedented level' during his most recent visit to China.

political.label: Japan rift
political.text: Tensions trace to PM Takaichi's Nov 2025 remark that a Chinese attack on Taiwan could be 'survival-threatening' for Japan — triggering a Chinese travel warning and a formal Japanese protest.

political.label: Domestic policy
political.text: New nationwide rental-market regulations were enacted to legalize and stabilize the sector — part of a wider domestic-demand push flagged by the Politburo.

hazard.label: Typhoon Dolphin
hazard.text: The most powerful typhoon to hit China in 2026 made landfall near Yuhuan, Zhejiang; over 1 million evacuated, ~1,500 Shanghai flights cancelled, and 98,900 evacuated in Fujian alone.

hazard.label: Typhoon Noul
hazard.text: The 12th typhoon of the year and 3rd that month battered southeastern China with flooding and high winds.

aviation.label: Unexplained 40-day NOTAM
aviation.text: China reserved coastal airspace larger than Taiwan (Yellow Sea to East China Sea) for 40 days with no announced exercise — an unprecedented duration flagged by independent OSINT trackers.

aviation.label: Drill-linked disruption
aviation.text: A CAAC NOTAM for the 'Justice Mission 2025' PLA drills disrupted 857 international and 84 domestic flights, affecting 100,000+ travelers.

strategic.label: Warhead estimate
strategic.text: China's operational nuclear stockpile is independently estimated at ~620 warheads as of mid-2026 (up from ~500 in 2023); the Pentagon projects it could exceed 1,000 by 2030.
strategic.source: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists / Arms Control Association

strategic.label: Delivery systems
strategic.text: ~775 land-based missile launchers are assessed, with roughly 475 ICBM-capable; three new ICBM silo fields in western China have been identified via commercial satellite imagery.

strategic.label: Test posture
strategic.text: China has observed a self-declared nuclear-testing moratorium since 1996 and is a CTBT signatory (not yet ratified); no detonation-test activity is indicated in current open-source monitoring.

strategic.label: CBRN readiness drill
strategic.text: The PLA Eastern Theater Command (East China Sea / Taiwan Strait area) ran a decontamination exercise simulating response to a nuclear-contamination scenario — a defensive readiness drill, not a weapons test.

social_china.label: Cybersecurity push
social_china.text: Xi Jinping elevated cybersecurity to a 'core national-security pillar' in a stated drive for 'cyber superpower' status — a top trending policy topic on Weibo.

social_china.label: Alipay privacy debate
social_china.text: A nationwide debate broke out after users rushed to revoke hidden data-sharing authorizations on Alipay.

social_china.label: Consumer transparency
social_china.text: A pre-made-dish labeling controversy involving a well-known restaurant chain became a multi-week trending topic, prompting calls for stricter food-labeling rules.

social_china.label: Rental-market reform
social_china.text: The new nationwide rental regulations were widely discussed as a rare 'comprehensive' step toward tenant protections.

social_global.label: Typhoon Dolphin
social_global.text: China's strongest 2026 typhoon and its mass evacuations dominated international wire coverage.

social_global.label: Drone-export curbs
social_global.text: China's Aug 5 sanctions and drone-export tightening — timed just ahead of Xi's Washington trip — drew wide Western financial-press coverage.

social_global.label: South China Sea
social_global.text: Water-cannon and baton-strike incidents near Scarborough and Second Thomas Shoals kept the dispute in international headlines, drawing US State Department statements.

social_global.label: Fujian carrier
social_global.text: Coverage of the Fujian's approach to full operational capability featured heavily in Western defense-trade press.

cyber.label: Volt Typhoon
cyber.text: US and allied agencies have repeatedly warned about Volt Typhoon, a state-linked actor assessed to be pre-positioning access inside US critical infrastructure networks.

cyber.label: Salt Typhoon
cyber.text: A separate state-linked intrusion set, Salt Typhoon, has been reported compromising major telecommunications providers, drawing sustained US government attention.

cyber.label: MSS attribution pattern
cyber.text: US indictments and advisories have repeatedly attributed a range of cyber-espionage campaigns to China's Ministry of State Security (MSS) and affiliated contractors.

space.label: Tiangong space station
space.text: China operates the Tiangong space station with rotating three-person crews, launched via Shenzhou missions from Jiuquan.

space.label: Lunar program
space.text: China's Chang'e lunar program has conducted sample-return and far-side missions, with crewed lunar landing plans stated for by 2030.

space.label: Beidou navigation system
space.text: China's Beidou satellite navigation system reached full global coverage, positioned as an alternative to GPS.
